summary: Iterasi 2 tested end-to-end (both backend+frontend). All 5 requested features work: Import Cepat (backend+UI), promo draft skeleton (draft visible in admin, NOT leaking to public), cron publish-scheduled (401 without auth, 200 with Bearer secret, scheduled article -> published), rich-text WYSIWYG editor (all format buttons present + typeable + persists), example-data badges/notes on 6/7 seeded vehicles + badge disappears after quick-import. Backend: 56/57 pytest passed. Frontend: super-admin login + all admin pages + public pages render OK. Prior iteration-1 CRITICAL bugs (staff .test emails, per-IP brute-force) are FIXED (verified: staff@bipoauto.com login OK, brute-force 429 seen on 6th attempt). One NEW backend bug found: lead_notification_email field is missing from stored site_settings doc because seed.py only inserts DEFAULT_SETTINGS when doc absent (non-idempotent for new keys). Field is exposed in Site Settings UI (defaults to empty) so admins can still set it via PUT — but out-of-the-box the seed value 'Reinaldyeffendiwork@gmail.com' never lands in DB.

minor.issue: New DEFAULT_SETTINGS keys (esp. lead_notification_email) are never merged into an already-existing site_settings document. seed.py line ~257: `if not await db.site_settings.find_one(...): insert`. On a DB seeded from iteration 1 (before this field existed), the notification email is missing -> notify_new_lead()/notify_new_test_drive() likely fall back to hardcoded default or no-op. Fix: use `update_one({...}, {'$setOnInsert': {...}, '$set': {k:v for missing keys}}, upsert=True)` OR `$set` only for keys not present via a per-key check.
Because of the above, admin.settings response object does NOT contain the field, but frontend still renders the input (uses schema, not response keys). Cosmetic mismatch; makes it easy to overlook.

rca_of_the_issue.lead_notification_email_missing_in_db: seed.py inserts DEFAULT_SETTINGS only if the site_settings document does not exist. In this preview environment the doc was already created during iteration-1 (before lead_notification_email was added to DEFAULT_SETTINGS in iteration-2). Restart / re-seed did not merge. Test proof: GET /api/admin/settings response keys do NOT contain 'lead_notification_email'. Reproduction: fresh DB -> field present; upgraded DB -> field absent. Mitigation: `for k, v in DEFAULT_SETTINGS.items(): update_one({'_key':'site_settings'}, {'$setOnInsert': {k:v}}, upsert=True)` per key, OR a `$set` on missing keys after fetching existing doc.
